body_privacy:
Data controller

Soronate, {{addr_l1}}, {{addr_l2}} – {{mail_l}}

Data we receive

The contact form sends nothing to a server of this site: it opens your email app (or Gmail) with a pre-filled message. We receive your name, email address, trip length, number of travellers, chosen stops and message only if you send that email yourself.

Purpose and legal basis

This data is used only to answer your request and to prepare a possible service (pre-contractual steps, GDPR article 6.1.b). It is never sold or used for advertising.

Retention

Your messages are kept while we handle your request, then for no more than 3 years after our last contact.

Cookies and local storage

The site uses no tracking cookies, no analytics and no advertising. Your browser only keeps your light or dark theme choice (local storage, key “t”), which is not linked to your identity.

Third-party services

  • Wikimedia Commons and Wikipedia: photographs are loaded from their servers, which therefore receive your IP address.
  • Open-Meteo: the Riga weather is requested from api.open-meteo.com, which receives your IP address and no other personal data.
  • GitHub Pages: the host may log connections for security reasons.
  • Gmail (Google): only if you choose to write with Gmail.

These services may be located outside the European Union, notably in the United States.

Your rights

You may request access to, correction, erasure, restriction or portability of your data, object to its processing and set instructions for its fate after your death by writing to {{mail_l}}. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).
body_a11y:
Our commitment

Soronate aims to make the SOROBALTE website accessible to as many people as possible, targeting level AA of WCAG 2.2 and the French RGAA 4 standard.

Compliance status

The site has not yet had a full audit: until it does, it is considered partially compliant.

What is in place

  • automatic home slideshow with a pause / play button;
  • a “Skip to content” link and keyboard navigation with visible focus;
  • the language of each page is declared (French, English, Latvian) and a language switcher is provided;
  • light / dark mode;
  • tabs, filters, gallery and image viewer usable by keyboard (arrows, Esc) and by touch;
  • touch targets of at least 44 px and labelled form fields;
  • animations switched off if your system asks for reduced motion;
  • resizable text and a layout adapted to small screens.

Known limitations

  • the map of Latvia is schematic: the same places are described in the experiences list;
  • photographs have a short alternative text, without detailed description;
  • contrast of text placed over a photograph may be insufficient depending on the image shown.

Contact us

If some content is not accessible to you, write to {{mail_l}} and we will offer an alternative as soon as possible.

Remedies

If you do not get a satisfactory answer, you can contact the French Défenseur des droits through its online form.
